hunt_karli: Silas Karli unpacked his brother's pocket watch at S-S5. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
seankukhta: The quartermaster asked Rafael "Whistle" Seankukhta to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
Rafael "Whistle" Seankukhta taught a recruit to recognize letters by sound. By supper, the whole table was tapping out Morse on the planks.
